description: This Java class 'EntityRelationController' manages REST API endpoints for creating, deleting, retrieving, and querying entity relations within the Thingsboard platform. It handles relation operations such as save, delete, get, and complex queries involving relation info objects, with security and permission checks.

classes.name: EntityRelationController
classes.description: Controller class providing REST API endpoints for managing entity relations in Thingsboard, including creation, deletion, retrieval, and complex queries with security checks.

methods.name: saveRelationV1
methods.description: Endpoint to create or update an entity relation with minimal security annotation.

methods.name: saveRelation
methods.description: Creates or updates an entity relation, returning the saved relation object.

methods.name: doSave
methods.description: Internal method to validate and save an entity relation.

methods.name: deleteRelationV1
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a relation between two entities with minimal security annotation.

methods.name: deleteRelation
methods.description: Deletes a relation between two entities, returning the deleted relation.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Internal method to validate parameters and delete a relation.

methods.name: deleteRelations
methods.description: Deletes all relations of a specific entity.

methods.name: getRelation
methods.description: Retrieves a relation object between two entities if it exists.

methods.name: findByFrom
methods.description: Finds relations originating from a specific entity.

methods.name: findEntityRelationsByFrom
methods.description: REST endpoint to find relations from an entity by type and ID.

methods.name: findInfoByFrom
methods.description: Finds relation info objects originating from a specific entity.

methods.name: findEntityRelationInfosByFrom
methods.description: REST endpoint to find relation info objects from an entity.

methods.name: findByTo
methods.description: Finds relations pointing to a specific entity.

methods.name: findEntityRelationsByTo
methods.description: REST endpoint to find relations to an entity by type and ID.

methods.name: findInfoByTo
methods.description: Finds relation info objects pointing to a specific entity.

methods.name: findEntityRelationInfosByTo
methods.description: REST endpoint to find relation info objects to an entity.

methods.name: findEntityRelationsByToAndRelationType
methods.description: Finds relations to an entity filtered by relation type.

methods.name: findEntityRelationsByQuery
methods.description: Finds all entities related to a specific entity based on complex query parameters.

methods.name: findEntityRelationInfosByQuery
methods.description: Finds all relation info objects related to a specific entity based on complex query parameters.

methods.name: checkCanCreateRelation
methods.description: Checks if the current user can create a relation involving the specified entity.

methods.name: filterRelationsByReadPermission
methods.description: Filters relations based on read permission checks.

methods.name: parseRelationTypeGroup
methods.description: Parses a string into a RelationTypeGroup enum, with default fallback.
